title: Public-company trading-comparables valuation
prompt:
Refresh the July 3 public-company trading-comparables analysis for the acquisition target labeled `Target` and send me an investment-committee valuation conclusion.

Use the July corporate-development correspondence, controller-reviewed peer support, dated market export, comparability decisions, and approved methodology in `Shared/Finance/Investor Relations/Peer analysis/`. Treat the June 27 banker pull only as change history, and follow the controller's warning on seller adjustments and proposed synergies. Keep this analysis separate from the Pioneer HVAC active-deal model and Alder Ridge's ledger.

Establish the approved peer population and lower, base, and upper valuation range through equity value. Reconstruct the full banker case using its EBITDA and complementary valuation weights, then bridge its equity-value uplift sequentially from the EBITDA change and the weight shift. Quantify the valuation contamination if the documented noncomparable peer were left in the median set.

For the small-sample review, compare the margin from the approved median multiples with the median of paired peer-level implied margins. Show how `Target` compares with the highest approved peer, test 70/30 weighting against an equal-weight control, and recalculate base equity value after removing each approved peer. Report the influence range, maximum swing, and number of removals at each bound. These controls do not replace the approved peer-set conclusion.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `approved_peer_count`, `excluded_peer`, `lower_quartile_implied_equity_value`, `implied_equity_value`, `upper_quartile_implied_equity_value`, `implied_equity_value_range_width`, `equity_value_range_width_pct_of_base`, `target_ebitda_margin`, `valuation_method_enterprise_value_spread`, `valuation_method_enterprise_value_spread_pct_of_revenue_value`, `banker_case_target_ltm_adjusted_ebitda`, `target_ebitda_reduction_from_banker_case`, `target_ebitda_reduction_pct_of_banker_case`, `banker_case_ebitda_valuation_weight`, `banker_case_revenue_valuation_weight`, `ebitda_weight_reduction_from_banker_case`, `banker_case_implied_equity_value`, `banker_case_equity_value_increase`, `banker_case_equity_value_increase_from_ebitda`, `banker_case_equity_value_increase_from_weight_shift`, `full_sample_implied_equity_value`, `outlier_contamination_equity_value_increase`, `outlier_contamination_equity_value_increase_pct_of_approved_base`, `median_peer_level_implied_ebitda_margin`, `ratio_of_medians_vs_peer_level_median_margin_spread`, `highest_approved_peer_implied_ebitda_margin`, `target_margin_premium_to_highest_approved_peer`, `equal_weight_implied_equity_value`, `approved_weighting_equity_value_premium_to_equal_weight`, `peer_a_removal_implied_equity_value`, `peer_b_removal_implied_equity_value`, `peer_c_removal_implied_equity_value`, `peer_d_removal_implied_equity_value`, `peer_e_removal_implied_equity_value`, `peer_g_removal_implied_equity_value`, `leave_one_out_min_implied_equity_value`, `leave_one_out_max_implied_equity_value`, `leave_one_out_equity_value_range`, `leave_one_out_max_absolute_swing_from_approved_base`, `leave_one_out_max_absolute_swing_pct_of_approved_base`, `leave_one_out_low_case_peer_removal_count`, `leave_one_out_high_case_peer_removal_count`. Use dollars to two decimals, counts as whole numbers, and multiples, ratios, and percentages as decimal values to at least four decimals.
